$comment: Single machine-readable source for environment-specific, non-secret identifiers. `scripts/sync_template_shared.py` STAMPS the template schema defaults from this file (run it, or `make sync-templates`, after editing); tests cross-check the remaining occurrences (databricks.yml variable defaults, Codex env expectations, and every *.md) so nothing can drift silently. When cloning this repo into another tenant/workspace, edit this file, run `make sync-templates`, and follow docs/enterprise-clone-runbook.md — that should be the whole identifier change.
$project_comment: Cost-attribution `project` tag applied to every job cluster and bundle preset. The cost anomaly watch buckets spend by this tag (src/aai_core/billing/usage.py), so a clone that leaves it pointing at another repository attributes its own spend to that repository forever.
$sdk_pip_source_comment: Where a generated project's CREDENTIAL-FREE CI installs aai-core from. Runtime jobs always install the checksum-pinned volume wheel instead, so this reaches only PR CI. It MUST resolve to exactly aai_core_version. A clone that leaves this pointing at another org's repository makes every generated project's CI depend on that repository — prefer an internal index ('aai-core=={{.aai_core_version}}') in an enterprise tenant.
